title.narrative: ILF for WASH Foundational Support (IMM+IR) for Aquatech Senegal

description.narrative: Scale - TA for Impact-Linked Finance for WASH (ILF for WASH)

The **Foundational Support Programme** is one of the [++technical assistance++](https://aquaforall.org/ilf-for-wash/ilf-for-wash-technical-assistance/) tracks available for impact-driven WASH enterprises, as part of the Impact-Linked Fund for Water, Sanitation and Hygiene ([++ILF for WASH++](https://aquaforall.org/ilf-for-wash/)). The programme is supported by the [++Social Finance Academy,++](https://social-finance-academy.org/) an initiative by Roots of Impact.
The programme aims to transfer knowledge and skills from certified service providers to WASH enterprises in two areas: **impact measurement and management (IMM)** and **investment readiness (IR)**. At the same time, the goal is to embed these areas into the specific business model of the selected enterprises.
One of the selected enterprises receiving support on both IMM and IR is Aquatech Senegal SA (hereinafter referred to as ‘Aquatech'). Aquatech provides water management services. They have a 10-year concession agreement with the government to serve a particular area (Thiès et Diourbel regions). The enterprise operates and maintains assets for drinking water production and distribution. In addition, they execute the billing and collection. Revenue comes from the consumers directly (water consumption in m3) based on a fixed tariff set by the government. Aquatech executes the billing and collection. Part of the collected fees is returned to government, for asset investment and major rehabilitation. Aquatech is member of an international group with a foreign investor (Helios).
In 2024, following successfull completion of the standard component of the Foundational Support programme, Aquatech was selected for the bonus component of the programme, for both the IMM and IR track.

title.narrative: Operationalisation of IMM system has been kickstarted.

description.narrative: This indicator is demonstrated by: 1) survey questionnaire development (i.e. survey forms); 2) demonstration of data collection activities (i.e. list of stakeholders / locations where data collection exercises are conducted); 3) survey responses and data organisation (i.e. data management system spreadsheet with indicator statuses updated); 4) Final Q&A and Feedback Session – attended by Aquatech, DevFi Performances and IMM mentor (Roots of Impact).

comment.narrative: Enterprise needs and will benefit from follow-on (bonus) support to operationalise the IMM process (completed during the standard component of the programme).

title.narrative: Enterprise is able to systematically collect, monitor, analyse and report on impact (data).

description.narrative: Enterprise has developed an internal IMM system, i.e. i) impact strategy/Theory of Change, ii) data collection strategy/process/templates, iii) data collection and monitoring system, iv) impact/decision-making report template. Hence, the enterprise is fully prepared for the next phase (beyond the scope of this TA project), i.e. to operationalise the IMM system by developing surveys, collecting baseline (impact) data, periodically update these data, create impact reports and use them to steer operational decision-making.

comment.narrative: The enterprise has to build an IMM strategy and system from scratch. The TA support will focus on raising awareness on the value of IMM (insight in and demonstration of impact) and getting the enterprises acquainted with concepts, tools and frameworks.

title.narrative: Enterprise is fully prepared to start raising (repayable) funding.

description.narrative: Enterprise has all documents in place that are required for fundraising (e.g. pitch decks, terms sheet) and a data room available for when funders request information. Hence, the enterprise is fully prepared for the next phase (beyond the scope of this TA project), i.e. to raise (repayable) investment, demonstrated by a signed terms sheet, Expression of Interest (EoI) or actual funding/investment agreement.

comment.narrative: The enterprise is looking for various funding sources in order to bridge the public funding gap. Any support in relation to investment readiness will be useful
